scheme_name: Package for strengthening to sugar co-operatives as may be policy decided by the State Government
other_conditions: Eligibility is limited to sugar co-operative societies and the members/farmers of those societies.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance to sugar co-operative societies for modernization, lab upgrades, storage improvements, and other projects, as well as direct cash assistance to farmers for the sale of bio‑compost, phospho‑compost and vermicompost.
